top: Use case: precise-object-edit. Replace the supplied space top scenery with a production 2D game SOLID CEILING WALL PNG. Preserve its slate-gray cratered asteroid-rock material, crisp painted/cel-shaded style and restrained violet rim light. Output a wide 2:1 image, requested 3072x1536, with REAL transparent alpha only on the open playable side. CRITICAL GAMEPLAY SHAPE: a continuous dense solid rock wall spanning the ENTIRE width, with a nearly horizontal inner contact face. Fill from the TOP edge down to 85% of image height with connected dense rock. Leave the bottom 15% transparent. The wall's lower contact contour runs almost horizontally across at 85% height, with only tiny natural chips and bumps of at most 1% image height. This is a thick cross-section of continuous asteroid bedrock: show many rows of small-to-medium interlocked cratered rocks and cracks. This must read as an impassable WALL at a flat collision boundary, NOT a mountain range, decorative border, pile of separate floating rocks, or a distant landscape. No valleys, hanging boulders, giant peaks, detached debris, transparent holes through the wall, space/stars/background, characters, UI, letters, frame, blur or fades. Do not digitally cut across a protruding rock: AUTHOR the wall rocks to meet the shallow level contact edge, with their complete small silhouettes intact. All depth extends OUTWARD away from the playable side. Outer top/bottom edge and left/right sides continue solid material to the canvas edge. Many small rocks, no giant boulders. Keep all detail sharp.
